question: In a woman presenting with antepartum haemorrhage at 34 weeks, a digital vaginal examination should be performed immediately to assess cervical dilation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is FALSE. Digital VE is absolutely contraindicated in APH. A finger-tip examination can rupture the placenta sinuses and convert a manageable bleed into life-threatening haemorrhage. Always obtain an ultrasound first.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. Digital vaginal examination is absolutely contraindicated in APH until placenta praevia has been excluded by ultrasonography, because it can precipitate catastrophic haemorrhage.
